title: Is there any animated dialogue text plugin for RPG Maker XP?

posts.author: rezdro
posts.body:
I want wavy, shake and maybe other type of animations for my dialogue text, like the text animations from OMORI for example.
I've been searching and really nothing comes out. Does anyone know of a script I can download?
If not, does anyone know if theres a way to code that? Im already a C# programmer so i can figure out how to make an RM XP script.

posts.author: KK20
posts.body: If each character (or a selection of them to be more efficient/performant) was represented as a Sprite, it would be pretty easy. Just requires a solution of how much kerning you'd put between each character and knowing when to wrap the text to the next line.
